source.citation: 'Prairie Avenue.' Halftone plate facing p. 199 in Picturesque Chicago and Guide to the World's Fair (Baltimore: R. H. Woodward and Co., 1892); photographer unrecorded. The same negative is printed as 'A Bit of Prairie Avenue' in Flinn's 1891 guide, as 'Looking south on Prairie Avenue from Eighteenth St.' in Flinn (1892 and 1893), and on the Alfred Holzman Company postcard 'Prairie Avenue' postmarked 1908 (Glessner House Museum).
